project: Wuxia Life P122 Early Visible Growth Feedback Minimal Implementation
description: Minimal implementation slice: turn early habit-driven growth from hidden runtime truth into player-visible confirmation on existing summary, feedback, and period-settlement surfaces. Single sample route merchant_house ages 5-12 only; no new growth system or multi-route expansion.

userStories.title: Lock merchant_house 5-8 sample baseline
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want the merchant_house 5-8 sample path and existing businessHabit thresholds locked before any expression work, so later stories target a single verifiable chain.
acceptanceCriteria: Fix sample scope to merchant_house only; primary age band 5-8 (PRD §7 Minimal Sample)
Sample actions locked: action_household_errand and action_household_apprentice
Confirm businessHabit >= 2 is the shaping confirmation threshold on existing habit wiring (no parallel system)
Baseline chain aligns with docs/test-reports/hvg-merchant-visible-growth-proof.md (errand -> apprentice -> businessHabit 2)
Do not parallelize a second origin/route sample (PRD §12 Risk 4, US-004)
Do not add new growth containers, panels, or skill trees (PRD §4 Out of Scope, FR-7, §12 Risk 1)
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: PRD §13 step 1 — lock sample before expression work. See also §11 Non-Goals.

userStories.title: Reinforce shapingSummary growth confirmation
userStories.description: As a player, I want the main screen to plainly tell me what kind of person I am becoming via existing summary surfaces, so early years feel like growth instead of passive playback.
acceptanceCriteria: On merchant_house 5-8 path, shapingSummary transitions from 塑形未成 to an explicit axis phrase (e.g. 营生 · 渐成) when businessHabit threshold is met (US-001, Signal A)
Confirmation text comes from existing habit/lifeStates wiring, not a new parallel system (US-001, FR-1)
Copy expresses growth direction, not repeated origin-background flavor (US-001, §10 Required Acceptance)
Player can clearly read that a business/营生 direction is forming (US-001)
Reuse MainScreenLifeSummary / existing tendencySummary+shapingSummary surfaces only; no new UI panel (PRD §6 P0, §4 Out of Scope)
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
userStories.notes: PRD §13 step 2 — expression layer first. FR-1.

userStories.title: Show long-term impact after shaping actions
userStories.description: As a player, I want shaping actions to leave visible long-term traces in the event feedback area, so I can connect my choices to my growth.
acceptanceCriteria: After sample shaping actions (action_household_errand / action_household_apprentice), feedback area shows at least one player-visible long-term impact confirmation (US-003, Signal C)
Confirmation is readable as this will continue to affect my life path, not only silver/stat deltas (US-003)
Reuse existing long-term impact / flag display mechanism; no new feedback framework (US-003, FR-2, PRD §6 P0)
Does not open a new branch at this step; causal visibility only (US-003)
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
userStories.notes: PRD §13 step 2 — feedback layer with expression layer. FR-2.

userStories.title: Add period settlement growth summary
userStories.description: As a player, I want age progression to tell me what growth line became clearer this period, so each age step feels like a meaningful change.
acceptanceCriteria: At least one age progression / period settlement on the sample path summarizes shaping change via existing periodSummaryDisplay (US-002, Signal B, FR-3)
Settlement copy answers what you grew into this period, not only generic narrative or stat fragments (US-002)
Summary correlates with prior shaping behavior, not passive age-based stat gain (US-002, PRD §4 Out of Scope)
Reuse GameScreen.vue periodSummaryDisplay; do not add an independent settlement system (US-002, PRD §6 P0)
Emphasis is growth confirmation, not repeated background flavor (FR-6, §10 Required Acceptance)
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
userStories.notes: PRD §13 step 3 — age progression settlement after expression/feedback. FR-3.

userStories.title: Improve 8-12 route echo readability
userStories.description: As a player, I want early growth confirmation to make later route continuation easier to read, so 8-12承接 feels like the result of what I already became.
acceptanceCriteria: At least one early growth confirmation is readable through existing echo/callback pattern (e.g. p9_echo_business_hook) (PRD §6 P1, FR-5)
On merchant_house 8-12 band, existing route flags (p9_early_business_focus, route_merchant, merchant_talent_discovery) read as follow-on from prior visible growth, not isolated events
Prove readability only; do not expand merchant 10-15 key fork content in this wave (PRD §4 Out of Scope, §11, US-004)
Stay on merchant_house single-route sample; no second-route parallel work (US-004, §12 Risk 4)
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: PRD §13 step 4 — 8-12 light continuation validation. See §6 P1 echo + route承接位.

userStories.title: Produce targeted visible-growth loop proof
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want one narrow merchant sample proof that the visible growth loop works, so later work can extend the pattern instead of reopening design.
acceptanceCriteria: Produce bounded proof for merchant_house ages 5-12 only (US-004, §10 Verification Standard)
Evidence shows behavior -> habit accumulation -> visible confirmation -> later continuation more readable
Player sees at least 2 different timepoint confirmation signals; at least 1 from summary/feedback and at least 1 from period settlement (§10 Required Acceptance)
Confirmation content distinguishes growth-happened from background flavor; no new system nouns required to explain growth (§10 Required Acceptance, FR-6)
Do not parallelize a second route; do not bundle merchant 10-15 fork reinforcement (US-004)
Save as docs/test-reports/p122-early-visible-growth-feedback-targeted-proof.md
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: US-004 proof artifact. PRD §14 — stop after sample is proven; do not expand into unified growth-system design.

userStories.title: Add narrow regression coverage
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want narrow automated tests guarding the early visible growth loop so future edits do not silently break player-facing confirmation.
acceptanceCriteria: Add tests/p122EarlyVisibleGrowthFeedbackTests.ts (or equivalent narrow harness file)
Cover shapingSummary confirmation on merchant_house 5-8 sample path
Cover long-term impact visibility after sample shaping actions
Cover periodSummaryDisplay growth summary tied to shaping behavior
Include scope guards: merchant_house only, no 10-15 fork expansion, no second-route parallelization
Existing hvg merchant visible-growth baseline evidence does not regress
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
userStories.notes: Regression guard for §10 verification chain. Reuse existing test harness patterns from P106/P119.
